deterministic_detail.outcome: Based on the areas inspected, the people met, and the documents reviewed, and considering the findings of the inspection, including the observations listed in the Inspection Report, Styrax Life Sciences Pvt. Limited, located at Plot No 5G, Rambili Mandal, Atchutapuram, Anakapalli, Andhra Pradesh, 531061; India was considered to be operating at an acceptable level of compliance with WHO Good Manufacturing Practices for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Guidelines. The deficiencies observed during the inspection, as listed in the full report, were addressed by Styrax Life Sciences Pvt. Limited to a satisfactory level before the publication of the WHOPIR. This WHOPIR will remain valid for 3 years, provided that the outcome of any inspection conducted during this period is positive.

sections.title: Quality management
sections.text: A Quality Unit, independent of production, was established. The persons authorized to release intermediates and APIs were clearly defined. Quality Assurance ensured compliance with quality standards across operations, products, and facilities. It managed and approved SOPs, batch records, and product release documentation, ensuring their accuracy and completeness. QA conducted audits, oversaw validations and qualifications, and provided GMP training. QA investigated deviations, out-of-specification results, and complaints, ensuring appropriate resolution. …
sections.text_ko: 생산부서로부터 독립된 품질 부서(Quality Unit)가 설치되어 있었다. 중간체 및 API의 출하를 승인할 권한이 있는 자가 명확히 정의되어 있었다. 품질보증(QA)은 운영, 제품 및 시설 전반에 걸쳐 품질 기준의 준수를 보장하였다. QA는 SOP, 배치 기록서 및 제품 출하 문서를 관리·승인하여 그 정확성과 완전성을 보장하였다. QA는 감사를 실시하고, 밸리데이션 및 적격성평가를 감독하였으며, GMP 교육을 제공하였다. QA는 일탈, 시험 기준 이탈(OOS) 결과 및 불만을 조사하여 적절한 해결을 보장하였다. …

sections.title: Personnel
sections.text: Personnel qualification An adequate number of personnel with appropriate qualifications, training, and experience were available for the manufacture and supervision of intermediates and APIs, with defined responsibilities documented in their job descriptions. The CV and job description of one authorized QA personnel responsible for batch release were reviewed. The manufacturer had a documented training system in place. …
sections.text_ko: 인원 적격성 중간체 및 API의 제조와 감독을 수행하기에 적절한 자격, 교육훈련 및 경험을 갖춘 인원이 충분한 수로 확보되어 있었으며, 직무기술서에 책임이 문서화되어 있었다. 배치 출하를 담당하는 QA 승인 인원 1명의 이력서(CV)와 직무기술서를 검토하였다. 제조업체는 문서화된 교육훈련 체계를 갖추고 있었다. …

sections.title: Buildings and facilities
sections.text: Design and construction According to the production schedule for the week of the inspection, no manufacturing activities were ongoing in Production Blocks V (PB-V) and VI (PB-VI). Nevertheless, these areas were included in the inspection to verify their general condition, cleanliness, and maintenance status. The areas were found to be maintained in an orderly condition. The facility layout was reviewed and followed a structured grid design with clearly segregated functional areas. …
sections.text_ko: 설계 및 구조 실사 주간의 생산 일정에 따르면 생산동 V(PB-V)와 VI(PB-VI)에서는 제조 활동이 진행되지 않았다. 그럼에도 이 구역들은 전반적인 상태, 청결 및 유지관리 상태를 확인하기 위해 실사에 포함되었다. 해당 구역은 정돈된 상태로 유지되고 있었다. 시설 배치도를 검토한 결과, 기능 구역이 명확히 분리된 체계적인 격자형 설계를 따르고 있었다. …

sections.title: Process equipment
sections.text: The manufacturer was observed to possess an adequate range and number of production equipment to support the manufacturing of APIs and intermediates. The installed equipment appeared to be generally appropriately selected in terms of capacity, design, and material of construction to meet process requirements and ensure product quality. A qualification and calibration schedule was available at the site. …
sections.text_ko: 제조업체는 API 및 중간체 제조를 뒷받침하기에 적절한 종류와 수량의 생산 설비를 보유하고 있는 것으로 확인되었다. 설치된 설비는 용량, 설계 및 재질 면에서 공정 요건을 충족하고 제품 품질을 보장하도록 대체로 적절하게 선정된 것으로 보였다. 적격성평가 및 교정 일정표가 현장에 비치되어 있었다. …

sections.title: Documentation and records
sections.text: All documents related to the manufacture of intermediates and APIs were prepared, reviewed, approved, and distributed in accordance with SOP on Good Documentation Practices (GDP), and were maintained in paper form. Measurements such as weighing were verified, and calculations were checked for accuracy. The issuance, revision, superseding, and withdrawal of documents were controlled in accordance with the respective SOP, and revision histories were appropriately maintained. …
sections.text_ko: 중간체 및 API의 제조와 관련된 모든 문서는 문서작성 우수관리기준(GDP) SOP에 따라 작성, 검토, 승인 및 배포되었으며 종이 형태로 보관되었다. 칭량 등의 측정은 확인되었고 계산은 정확성을 점검하였다. 문서의 발행, 개정, 대체 및 폐기는 해당 SOP에 따라 관리되었으며 개정 이력이 적절히 유지되었다. …

sections.title: Materials management
sections.text: The manufacturer had established multiple SOPs governing the receipt, identification, quarantine, storage, handling, sampling, testing, and approval or rejection of materials, including SOP for Receipt, Inspection, Labelling and Handling of Raw Material and Packing Materials, and SOP for Sampling, Testing and Approval of Raw Material and Packing Material. All related activities were managed using a paper‑based system. Upon receipt and prior to acceptance, each container or grouping of containers of materials was visually examined. …
sections.text_ko: 제조업체는 원자재의 입고, 식별, 격리, 보관, 취급, 시료채취, 시험, 승인 또는 불합격을 규율하는 여러 SOP를 수립하고 있었으며, 여기에는 원료 및 포장재의 입고, 검사, 라벨링 및 취급 SOP(SOP for Receipt, Inspection, Labelling and Handling of Raw Material and Packing Materials)와 원료 및 포장재의 시료채취, 시험 및 승인 SOP(SOP for Sampling, Testing and Approval of Raw Material and Packing Material)가 포함되었다. 관련 활동은 모두 종이 기반 시스템으로 관리되었다. 입고 시 그리고 인수 전에 각 용기 또는 용기 묶음은 육안으로 검사되었다. …

sections.title: Production and in-process controls
sections.text: Production operation Raw materials used in the manufacture of intermediates and APIs were weighed or measured. Critical weighing, measuring, and subdividing operations were verified. Prior to use, production personnel confirmed that materials corresponded to those specified in the batch records for the intended intermediate or API. Actual yields were compared with expected yields at designated stages of the production process in the BPR, and expected yield ranges were established during process development. …
sections.text_ko: 생산 작업 중간체 및 API 제조에 사용되는 원료는 칭량 또는 계량되었다. 핵심 칭량, 계량 및 소분 작업은 확인되었다. 사용 전에 생산 인원은 해당 물질이 의도한 중간체 또는 API의 배치 기록서에 명시된 것과 일치하는지 확인하였다. 실제 수율은 BPR에 지정된 생산 공정의 단계에서 예상 수율과 비교되었으며, 예상 수율 범위는 공정 개발 중에 설정되었다. …

sections.title: Packaging and identification labelling of APIs and intermediates
sections.text: General: Procedures were established describing the receipt, identification, quarantine, sampling, examination and/or testing, release, and handling of packaging materials. Preparation of product labels was performed in accordance with the respective SOP. Labels were generated using an application that generated a unique barcode. Labels were issued based on production requests, for the exact quantity required for each batch and for the designated number of containers, including both inner and outer containers. …
sections.text_ko: 일반: 포장재의 입고, 식별, 격리, 시료채취, 검사 및/또는 시험, 출하 및 취급을 기술하는 절차가 수립되어 있었다. 제품 라벨의 작성은 해당 SOP에 따라 수행되었다. 라벨은 고유 바코드를 생성하는 애플리케이션을 사용하여 생성되었다. 라벨은 생산 요청에 따라 각 배치에 필요한 정확한 수량으로, 내부 및 외부 용기를 모두 포함하여 지정된 용기 수에 맞추어 발행되었다. …
sections.title_ko: API 및 중간체의 포장 및 식별 라벨링

sections.title: Laboratory controls
sections.text: The independent Quality Unit had adequate laboratory facilities. Written procedures covered sampling, testing, approval or rejection of materials, and the management and storage of laboratory data. Laboratory records were maintained in accordance with established requirements. Sampling equipment was stored in the QC laboratory under the supervision of the QC unit. Non‑dedicated sampling tools were cleaned, packed, and labelled with the date of cleaning. …
sections.text_ko: 독립된 품질 부서는 적절한 시험 시설을 갖추고 있었다. 문서화된 절차가 시료채취, 시험, 물질의 승인 또는 불합격, 그리고 시험실 데이터의 관리 및 보관을 다루고 있었다. 시험실 기록은 확립된 요건에 따라 유지되었다. 시료채취 장비는 QC 부서의 감독 하에 QC 시험실에 보관되었다. 전용이 아닌 시료채취 도구는 세척, 포장되고 세척 일자가 표기되었다. …

sections.title: Validation
sections.text: Validation documentation A limited verification was performed, consisting of confirming the existence of the Validation Master Plan (VMP) and the calibration program. Process validation documentation Process validation ensured consistent manufacturing performance and product quality through defined and verified stages, including process design, process qualification, and continued process verification. It involved documentation of raw materials, equipment, process parameters, and calibration requirements. …
sections.text_ko: 밸리데이션 문서 밸리데이션 마스터 플랜(VMP)과 교정 프로그램의 존재를 확인하는 제한적인 검증이 수행되었다. 공정 밸리데이션 문서 공정 밸리데이션은 공정 설계, 공정 적격성평가 및 지속적 공정 검증을 포함하는 정의되고 검증된 단계를 통해 일관된 제조 성능과 제품 품질을 보장하였다. 여기에는 원자재, 설비, 공정 변수 및 교정 요건의 문서화가 수반되었다. …

sections.title: Change control
sections.text: A formal change control system was established to evaluate changes that could impact the production and control of intermediates or APIs. The relevant SOP was in place and reviewed during the inspection and found to be satisfactory. The procedures covered the identification, documentation, review, and approval of changes related to raw materials, specifications, analytical methods, facilities, support systems, equipment (including computer hardware), processing steps, labelling and packaging materials, and computer software. …
sections.text_ko: 중간체 또는 API의 생산 및 관리에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 변경을 평가하기 위한 공식적인 변경관리 체계가 수립되어 있었다. 관련 SOP가 마련되어 있었고 실사 중 검토되어 만족스러운 것으로 확인되었다. 절차는 원자재, 규격, 시험방법, 시설, 지원 시스템, 설비(컴퓨터 하드웨어 포함), 공정 단계, 라벨링 및 포장재, 컴퓨터 소프트웨어와 관련된 변경의 식별, 문서화, 검토 및 승인을 다루고 있었다. …

sections.title: Rejection and re-use of materials
sections.text: Reprocessing and reworking SOP for Reprocessing and Reworking of Intermediates and APIs was established to define the requirements and controls governing reprocessing and reworking activities and was reviewed during the inspection and found to be adequate. The procedure clearly differentiated between reprocessing and reworking as controlled, non- routine activities intended to bring non-conforming intermediates or APIs into compliance. …
sections.text_ko: 재처리 및 재작업 중간체 및 API의 재처리 및 재작업 SOP(SOP for Reprocessing and Reworking of Intermediates and APIs)가 재처리 및 재작업 활동을 규율하는 요건과 관리를 정하기 위해 수립되어 있었으며, 실사 중 검토되어 적절한 것으로 확인되었다. 이 절차는 재처리와 재작업을 부적합 중간체 또는 API를 적합하게 만들기 위한 관리된 비정기 활동으로 명확히 구분하고 있었다. …

sections.title: Complaints and recalls
sections.text: All quality-related complaints, whether received orally or in writing, were recorded and investigated in accordance with the SOP for handling of market complaints. The documentation of one randomly selected complaint was reviewed. Complaint records included the name and address of the complainant, contact details of the person submitting the complaint, the nature of the complaint (including the API name and batch number), and the date of receipt. …
sections.text_ko: 구두 또는 서면으로 접수된 모든 품질 관련 불만은 시판 후 불만 처리 SOP(SOP for handling of market complaints)에 따라 기록되고 조사되었다. 무작위로 선정된 불만 1건의 문서를 검토하였다. 불만 기록에는 불만 제기자의 이름과 주소, 불만을 제출한 사람의 연락처, 불만의 성격(API명과 배치 번호 포함) 및 접수 일자가 포함되어 있었다. …

sections.title: Contract manufacturers (including laboratories)
sections.text: A list of testing laboratories and other service providers, included as Annexure III of the SMF, was available. The following documentation was reviewed: - SOP for approval procedures of contract manufacturers, testing laboratories, and other service providers; - The quality agreement with the contract testing laboratory, and it was verified that it included provisions for documentation retention, confidentiality, and the right to audit; - The onsite audit report to verify compliance with GLP procedures and practices. The corresponding audit checklist was also available and reviewed. …
sections.text_ko: SMF의 Annexure III로 포함된 시험기관 및 기타 서비스 제공업체 목록이 구비되어 있었다. 다음 문서를 검토하였다. - 위탁 제조업체, 시험기관 및 기타 서비스 제공업체의 승인 절차 SOP; - 위탁 시험기관과의 품질 협약서(quality agreement)로서, 문서 보존, 기밀 유지 및 감사 권리에 관한 규정이 포함되어 있음이 확인되었다; - GLP 절차 및 관행의 준수를 확인하기 위한 현장 감사 보고서. 해당 감사 체크리스트도 구비되어 있어 검토하였다. …

deterministic_detail.outcome_ko: 점검한 구역, 면담한 인원, 검토한 문서를 바탕으로, 그리고 실사 보고서(Inspection Report)에 기재된 관찰사항을 포함한 실사 결과를 고려하여, Plot No 5G, Rambili Mandal, Atchutapuram, Anakapalli, Andhra Pradesh, 531061; India에 소재한 Styrax Life Sciences Pvt. Limited는 WHO 원료의약품 GMP 가이드라인(WHO Good Manufacturing Practices for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Guidelines)에 대해 허용 가능한 수준의 준수 상태로 운영되고 있는 것으로 판단되었다. 전체 보고서에 기재된 실사 중 확인된 미비사항은 WHOPIR 공표 이전에 Styrax Life Sciences Pvt. Limited에 의해 만족스러운 수준으로 시정되었다. 이 WHOPIR는 해당 기간 중 수행되는 모든 실사의 결과가 긍정적인 경우에 한하여 3년간 유효하다.

en.title_issue: WHO inspection report on an API manufacturer
en.summary: WHO published a public inspection report (WHOPIR) for Styrax Life Science Pvt Ltd (Anakapalli), inspected 2026-06-01. Under quality management, a Quality Unit independent of production and designated release approvers for intermediates and API were confirmed.
en.implication: That the WHOPIR quality management section first confirmed Quality Unit independence and definition of release approval authority signals that these two elements are basic checkpoints in API manufacturer assessment. A company sourcing API from this manufacturer should read the full report as supplier evaluation material.
key_facts: Subject: Styrax Life Science Pvt Ltd (Anakapalli)
Inspection date: 2026-06-01
Quality management: Quality Unit independent of production established
Release approval: Release approvers for intermediates and API clearly designated
checks: Independence of the Quality Unit from the production department
Designation of release approvers for intermediates and API and documentation of their authority

cards.title_issue: 통합 QA 조직 운영 실사 보고
cards.summary: WHO는 Styrax Pharma (Andhra Pradesh)에 대한 2026-05-26 실사 공개 보고서(WHOPIR)를 게시했으며, 독립된 Quality Assurance Unit이 QA와 QC 기능을 함께 수행하는 것으로 확인됐다.
key_facts: 대상: Styrax Pharma (Andhra Pradesh)
품질경영: 독립된 Quality Assurance Unit 운영
기능: 하나의 조직이 QA·QC 기능을 모두 수행
cards.implication: 하나의 독립 조직이 QA와 QC 기능을 모두 수행하는 구조도 WHOPIR에서 수용된 사례로, 조직 형태보다 독립성 확보가 평가 핵심이라는 신호다. 통합 조직 구조에서는 시험 결과 검토와 출하 판정 간 견제가 어떻게 유지되는지 점검해 둘 필요가 있다.
checks: 통합 QA 조직 내 QC 시험 검토와 출하 판정 간 견제 장치
Quality Assurance Unit의 생산으로부터의 독립성

deterministic_detail.outcome: Based on the areas inspected, the people met, and the documents reviewed, and considering the findings of the inspection, including the observations listed in the Inspection Report, Styrax Pharma Pvt Ltd., located at Plot No. 27B, Jawaharlal Nehru Pharma City, Parawada, Anakapalli, Andhra Pradesh, 531021, India, was considered to be operating at an acceptable level of compliance with WHO Good Manufacturing Practices for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Guidelines. The deficiencies observed during the inspection, as listed in the full report, were addressed by Styrax Pharma Pvt Ltd. to a satisfactory level before the publication of the WHOPIR. This WHOPIR will remain valid for 3 years, provided that the outcome of any inspection conducted during this period is positive

sections.title: Quality management
sections.text: An independent Quality Assurance Unit was in place and fulfilled both quality assurance and quality control functions. The Quality Assurance department was responsible for ensuring overall compliance with product quality, operations, and facilities in accordance with established procedures and policies. QA oversaw the preparation, review, approval, and periodic revision of SOPs across all departments. It was responsible for the approval and control of master batch production records, the issuance and review of batch production records, and the maintenance of master documentation. …
sections.text_ko: 독립된 품질보증 부서(Quality Assurance Unit)가 설치되어 있었으며 품질보증과 품질관리 기능을 모두 수행하였다. 품질보증 부서는 확립된 절차와 방침에 따라 제품 품질, 운영 및 시설 전반의 준수를 보장할 책임이 있었다. QA는 모든 부서의 SOP 작성, 검토, 승인 및 정기 개정을 감독하였다. QA는 마스터 배치 생산 기록서의 승인 및 관리, 배치 생산 기록서의 발행 및 검토, 마스터 문서의 유지관리를 담당하였다. …

sections.title: Personnel
sections.text: Personnel qualification There was an adequate number of personnel qualified by appropriate education, training, and/or experience to perform and supervise the manufacture of intermediates and APIs. The responsibilities of all personnel engaged in the manufacture of intermediates and APIs were specified in their respective job descriptions. Training was conducted regularly in accordance with the SOP, by qualified personnel and, at a minimum, covered: - the specific operations performed by the employee; and - GMP as it related to the employee’s functions. …
sections.text_ko: 인원 적격성 중간체 및 API의 제조를 수행하고 감독하기에 적절한 학력, 교육훈련 및/또는 경험을 갖춘 인원이 충분히 확보되어 있었다. 중간체 및 API 제조에 종사하는 모든 인원의 책임은 각자의 직무기술서에 명시되어 있었다. 교육훈련은 SOP에 따라 자격을 갖춘 인원에 의해 정기적으로 실시되었으며, 최소한 다음을 포함하였다. - 해당 직원이 수행하는 특정 작업; 및 - 해당 직원의 기능과 관련된 GMP. …

sections.title: Buildings and facilities
sections.text: According to the production schedule for the week of the inspection, no manufacturing activities were taking place in PB-I and PB-III. Nevertheless, these areas were included in the inspection to verify their general condition, cleanliness, and maintenance status, along with the warehouses, including the packaging and dispensing area, drum yard, and solvent farm. The premises consisted of different areas. Changing rooms were provided before each cleanroom in Clean Area Block II, with appropriate gowning instructions displayed. …
sections.text_ko: 실사 주간의 생산 일정에 따르면 PB-I 및 PB-III에서는 제조 활동이 진행되지 않았다. 그럼에도 이 구역들은 포장 및 칭량 구역, 드럼 야드, 용매 저장구역(solvent farm)을 포함한 창고와 함께 전반적인 상태, 청결 및 유지관리 상태를 확인하기 위해 실사에 포함되었다. 건물은 여러 구역으로 구성되어 있었다. Clean Area Block II의 각 청정실 앞에는 갱의실이 마련되어 있었고 적절한 가운 착용 지침이 게시되어 있었다. …

sections.title: Process equipment
sections.text: Design and construction The manufacturer was equipped with the necessary equipment required for the production of its products. All equipment in direct contact with products was constructed from suitable materials (SS316, borosilicate glass, or Hastelloy) to prevent any impact on product quality. Equipment used for manufacturing intermediates and APIs was labelled, designed, and located to facilitate proper operation, cleaning, and maintenance. Equipment maintenance and cleaning Product changeover cleaning procedures were in place, and equipment cleanliness was verified by QA prior to reuse. …
sections.text_ko: 설계 및 구조 제조업체는 제품 생산에 필요한 설비를 갖추고 있었다. 제품과 직접 접촉하는 모든 설비는 제품 품질에 영향이 없도록 적합한 재질(SS316, 붕규산 유리 또는 Hastelloy)로 제작되었다. 중간체 및 API 제조에 사용되는 설비는 적정한 작동, 세척 및 유지관리가 용이하도록 라벨이 부착되고 설계되고 배치되어 있었다. 설비 유지관리 및 세척 제품 교체 시 세척 절차가 마련되어 있었고, 설비의 청결은 재사용 전에 QA에 의해 확인되었다. …

sections.title: Documentation and records
sections.text: Document control was managed in accordance with the applicable SOP. Approved documents were designated as “MASTER COPY” and served as the source for issuing controlled versions. Most of the company’s operations were paper-based. Copies distributed to relevant departments were stamped as “CONTROLLED COPY” to ensure traceability and prevent unauthorized use. Formats and documents were reproduced from the master copy and issued with appropriate company identification. …
sections.text_ko: 문서 관리는 해당 SOP에 따라 이루어졌다. 승인된 문서는 “MASTER COPY”로 지정되었으며 관리 사본을 발행하는 원본으로 사용되었다. 회사 운영의 대부분은 종이 기반이었다. 관련 부서에 배포된 사본에는 추적성을 보장하고 무단 사용을 방지하기 위해 “CONTROLLED COPY” 도장이 찍혔다. 서식과 문서는 마스터 사본으로부터 복제되었으며 적절한 회사 식별 표시와 함께 발행되었다. …

sections.title: Materials management
sections.text: The manufacturer had established multiple SOPs governing the receipt, identification, quarantine, storage, handling, sampling, testing, and approval or rejection of materials. All processes were managed using a paper-based system. Upon receipt, raw materials were initially verified against the approved supplier list in the receiving area, cleaned, and subsequently transferred to the warehouse, where quarantine status labels were issued by warehouse personnel. …
sections.text_ko: 제조업체는 원자재의 입고, 식별, 격리, 보관, 취급, 시료채취, 시험, 승인 또는 불합격을 규율하는 여러 SOP를 수립하고 있었다. 모든 과정은 종이 기반 시스템으로 관리되었다. 입고 시 원료는 입고 구역에서 먼저 승인 공급업체 목록과 대조하여 확인되고 세척된 후 창고로 이송되었으며, 창고에서 창고 담당자가 격리 상태 라벨을 발행하였다. …

sections.title: Production and in-process controls
sections.text: The facility operated under a structured shift system to ensure continuous production. The general shift ran from 09:00 to 17:30, while operations were supported by three rotating shifts: A shift from 06:00 to 14:00, B shift from 14:00 to 22:00, and C shift from 22:00 to 06:00. This arrangement enabled uninterrupted 24/7 operations to meet market demand and customer timelines. Production operation Raw materials for the manufacture of intermediates and APIs were weighed or measured under appropriate conditions. Weighing and measuring devices were of suitable accuracy for their intended use. …
sections.text_ko: 시설은 연속 생산을 보장하기 위해 체계적인 교대 근무 체계로 운영되었다. 일반 근무는 09:00부터 17:30까지였으며, 운영은 세 개의 교대 근무조가 뒷받침하였다. A조는 06:00부터 14:00, B조는 14:00부터 22:00, C조는 22:00부터 06:00까지였다. 이러한 체계로 시장 수요와 고객 일정을 충족하기 위한 연중무휴 24시간 중단 없는 운영이 가능하였다. 생산 작업 중간체 및 API 제조용 원료는 적절한 조건에서 칭량 또는 계량되었다. 칭량 및 계량 기기는 의도한 용도에 적합한 정확도를 갖추고 있었다. …

sections.title: Packaging and identification labelling of APIs and intermediates
sections.text: Materials were transferred using scoops into pre-weighed, food-grade white LDPE bags (primary packaging), which were then placed into black LDPE bags (secondary packaging) within HDPE or fiber drums. Both primary and secondary bags were twisted and sealed with pilfer-proof seals. The containers were subsequently closed with lids and secured using electroplated metal rings, which were locked with tamper-evident stainless-steel seals embossed with the company logo and serial number, ensuring traceability and integrity.
sections.text_ko: 물질은 스쿱을 사용하여 미리 칭량된 식품등급 백색 LDPE 백(1차 포장)에 옮겨 담았고, 이를 다시 HDPE 또는 파이버 드럼 안의 흑색 LDPE 백(2차 포장)에 넣었다. 1차 및 2차 백은 모두 꼬아서 도난 방지 씰로 밀봉되었다. 이후 용기는 뚜껑으로 닫고 전기도금 금속 링으로 고정하였으며, 이 링은 회사 로고와 일련번호가 양각된 개봉 방지용 스테인리스강 씰로 잠겨 추적성과 무결성이 보장되었다.
sections.title_ko: API 및 중간체의 포장 및 식별 라벨링

sections.title: Storage and distribution
sections.text: Refer to previous sections for storage.
sections.text_ko: 보관에 대해서는 이전 항목을 참조.

sections.title: Laboratory controls
sections.text: Quality Control activities included the preparation and review of specifications and analytical methods for raw materials, packaging materials, in-process samples, intermediates, and finished products. The department was responsible for sampling and testing at all stages of production, including stability and holding time studies. …
sections.text_ko: 품질관리 활동에는 원료, 포장재, 공정 중 시료, 중간체 및 완제품에 대한 규격과 시험방법의 작성 및 검토가 포함되었다. 해당 부서는 안정성 및 보관시간(holding time) 시험을 포함하여 생산의 모든 단계에서 시료채취와 시험을 담당하였다. …

sections.title: Validation
sections.text: Validation documentation Validation Master Plan was reviewed. Systems and processes were periodically evaluated to verify that they continued to operate in a validated state. Where no significant changes had been made to the system or process, and quality reviews confirmed consistent production of materials meeting specifications, revalidation was not required. Validation and qualification of critical systems, including computerized systems, processes, and analytical methods, were considered essential to ensure the reliability and integrity of the data generated and managed by these systems. …
sections.text_ko: 밸리데이션 문서 밸리데이션 마스터 플랜을 검토하였다. 시스템과 공정은 밸리데이션된 상태로 계속 운영되고 있는지 확인하기 위해 주기적으로 평가되었다. 시스템 또는 공정에 중대한 변경이 없고 품질 검토에서 규격에 부합하는 물질이 일관되게 생산되고 있음이 확인된 경우, 재밸리데이션은 요구되지 않았다. 전산화 시스템, 공정 및 시험방법을 포함한 핵심 시스템의 밸리데이션과 적격성평가는 이들 시스템이 생성하고 관리하는 데이터의 신뢰성과 완전성을 보장하는 데 필수적인 것으로 간주되었다. …

sections.title: Change control
sections.text: A formal change control system was established in accordance with the applicable SOP. The SOP defined procedures for documenting, reviewing, assessing, implementing, and controlling all proposed changes related to documents, procedures, processes, raw materials, vendors, equipment, and facilities used in the manufacture of APIs and intermediates. A list of change categories was included in the SOP; however, it was specified that the list was not exhaustive and that other changes could also be subject to the change control procedure. Change control requests were randomly selected and reviewed. …
sections.text_ko: 해당 SOP에 따라 공식적인 변경관리 체계가 수립되어 있었다. SOP는 API 및 중간체 제조에 사용되는 문서, 절차, 공정, 원자재, 공급업체, 설비 및 시설과 관련된 모든 제안된 변경을 문서화, 검토, 평가, 이행 및 관리하는 절차를 정하고 있었다. SOP에는 변경 범주 목록이 포함되어 있었으나, 해당 목록이 모든 것을 망라하는 것은 아니며 다른 변경도 변경관리 절차의 대상이 될 수 있다고 명시되어 있었다. 변경관리 요청서를 무작위로 선정하여 검토하였다. …

sections.title: Rejection and re-use of materials
sections.text: Rejection Intermediates and APIs that did not meet established specifications were identified and quarantined. Reprocessing and reworking The manufacturer had SOP for Re-Processing and Re-Working of Intermediates and APIs, in place. The procedure described the requirements and processes for reprocessing and reworking activities and was reviewed during the inspection and found to be adequate. Both reprocessing and reworking were defined as controlled, non-routine activities used to bring non-conforming intermediates or APIs into compliance, with clear distinction between the two. …
sections.text_ko: 불합격 설정된 규격에 부합하지 않는 중간체 및 API는 식별되어 격리되었다. 재처리 및 재작업 제조업체는 중간체 및 API의 재처리 및 재작업 SOP(SOP for Re-Processing and Re-Working of Intermediates and APIs)를 갖추고 있었다. 이 절차는 재처리 및 재작업 활동의 요건과 과정을 기술하고 있었으며 실사 중 검토되어 적절한 것으로 확인되었다. 재처리와 재작업은 모두 부적합 중간체 또는 API를 적합하게 만들기 위해 사용되는 관리된 비정기 활동으로 정의되어 있었고, 두 가지는 명확히 구별되어 있었다. …

sections.title: Complaints and recalls
sections.text: All quality-related complaints, whether received orally or in writing, were recorded and investigated in accordance with the SOP on Handling of Complaints. Complaint records included the name and address of the complainant, contact details of the person submitting the complaint, the nature of the complaint (including API name and batch number), the date of receipt, details of initial and follow-up actions (including dates and responsible personnel), the response provided to the complainant (including the response date), and the final decision regarding the intermediate or API batch or lot. …
sections.text_ko: 구두 또는 서면으로 접수된 모든 품질 관련 불만은 불만 처리 SOP(SOP on Handling of Complaints)에 따라 기록되고 조사되었다. 불만 기록에는 불만 제기자의 이름과 주소, 불만을 제출한 사람의 연락처, 불만의 성격(API명과 배치 번호 포함), 접수 일자, 초기 및 후속 조치의 세부 내용(일자와 담당자 포함), 불만 제기자에게 제공된 회신(회신 일자 포함), 그리고 해당 중간체 또는 API 배치 또는 로트에 대한 최종 결정이 포함되어 있었다. …

sections.title: Contract manufacturers (including laboratories)
sections.text: A list of contractors was available as Annexure V of the Site Master File. Contract manufacturers, including contract testing laboratories and service providers, were evaluated by the contract giver to ensure GMP compliance for the specific operations performed at the contract sites, in accordance with the corresponding SOP. A written and approved contract or formal agreement was in place between the contract giver and the contract acceptor, defining the GMP responsibilities and quality requirements of each party. …
sections.text_ko: 계약업체 목록이 Site Master File의 Annexure V로 구비되어 있었다. 위탁 시험기관 및 서비스 제공업체를 포함한 위탁 제조업체는 해당 SOP에 따라, 위탁 현장에서 수행되는 특정 작업에 대한 GMP 준수를 확인하기 위해 위탁자(contract giver)에 의해 평가되었다. 위탁자와 수탁자(contract acceptor) 사이에 각 당사자의 GMP 책임과 품질 요건을 정하는 서면 승인 계약 또는 공식 합의서가 체결되어 있었다. …

deterministic_detail.outcome_ko: 점검한 구역, 면담한 인원 및 검토한 문서를 바탕으로, 그리고 실사 보고서(Inspection Report)에 기재된 관찰사항을 포함한 실사 결과를 고려하여, Plot No. 27B, Jawaharlal Nehru Pharma City, Parawada, Anakapalli, Andhra Pradesh, 531021, India에 소재한 Styrax Pharma Pvt Ltd.는 WHO 원료의약품 GMP 가이드라인(WHO Good Manufacturing Practices for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Guidelines)에 대해 허용 가능한 수준의 준수 상태로 운영되고 있는 것으로 판단되었다. 전체 보고서에 기재된 실사 중 확인된 미비사항은 WHOPIR 공표 이전에 Styrax Pharma Pvt Ltd.에 의해 만족스러운 수준으로 시정되었다. 이 WHOPIR는 해당 기간 중 수행되는 모든 실사의 결과가 긍정적인 경우에 한하여 3년간 유효하다

en.title_issue: WHO inspection of a combined QA/QC unit
en.summary: WHO published a public inspection report (WHOPIR) for Styrax Pharma (Andhra Pradesh) from the 2026-05-26 inspection, noting that an independent Quality Assurance Unit performs both QA and QC functions.
en.implication: A single independent unit covering both QA and QC was accepted in the WHOPIR, a sign that independence matters more than organizational form in the assessment. Where QA and QC are combined, check how checks and balances are kept between test result review and batch release decisions.
key_facts: Subject: Styrax Pharma (Andhra Pradesh)
Inspection date: 2026-05-26
Quality management: independent Quality Assurance Unit in operation
Function: one unit performs both QA and QC functions
checks: Checks and balances between QC test review and release decisions in a combined QA unit
Independence of the Quality Assurance Unit from production

cards.summary: WHO는 Hetero Labs (Unit III Jeedimetla - FPP)에 대한 2026-04-27 실사 공개 보고서(WHOPIR)를 게시했으며, 주요 품질 요소를 다루는 절차를 갖춘 문서화된 품질보증 시스템이 확인됐다.
key_facts: 대상: Hetero Labs (Unit III Jeedimetla - FPP)
시설 구분: FPP
품질시스템: 주요 품질 요소를 다루는 절차를 갖춘 문서화된 QA 시스템
cards.implication: 완제의약품(FPP) 시설 WHOPIR가 품질시스템 문서화 확인으로 시작하는 것은 절차 체계 완비가 WHO 실사 평가의 기본 전제라는 신호다. 이 시설을 완제품 공급원으로 둔 업체라면 보고서 후속 항목을 위탁 제조소 관리 자료로 확인해 둘 필요가 있다.
checks: 완제품 위탁 제조소 WHOPIR 확보 및 검토 여부
품질시스템 절차가 주요 품질 요소를 포괄하는지 여부

deterministic_detail.outcome: Based on the areas inspected, the people met and the documents reviewed, and considering the findings of the inspection, including the observations listed in the Inspection Report, Hetero Laboratories Limited (Unit-III) located at Survey No. 51, Plot 22-110, Industrial Development Area (I.D.A.), Jeedimetla, Hyderabad-500055, Telangana State, India was considered to be operating at an acceptable level of compliance with WHO GMP Guidelines. All the non-compliances observed during the inspection that were listed in the full report as well as those reflected in the WHOPIR, were addressed by the manufacturer, to a satisfactory level, prior to the publication of the WHOPIR. This WHOPIR will remain valid for three years, provided that the outcome of any inspection con- ducted during this period is positive.

sections.title: Pharmaceutical quality system
sections.text: A documented system for quality assurance was established, with procedures covering key quality elements in place. The Quality Department was divided into QA and QC and were separate from the Production Department. Operations were specified in written form and critical GMP requirements were essentially being met. The procedures reviewed and discussed during the inspection were generally of an acceptable standard. Annual Product Quality Review (APQR) The company had a procedure in place for performing annual product quality reviews. …
sections.text_ko: 품질보증을 위한 문서화된 체계가 수립되어 있었고, 핵심 품질 요소를 다루는 절차가 마련되어 있었다. 품질 부서는 QA와 QC로 나뉘어 있었으며 생산 부서와 분리되어 있었다. 작업은 서면으로 명시되어 있었고 중요한 GMP 요건은 기본적으로 충족되고 있었다. 실사 중 검토하고 논의한 절차는 대체로 허용 가능한 수준이었다. 연간 제품 품질 검토(APQR) 회사는 연간 제품 품질 검토를 수행하기 위한 절차를 갖추고 있었다. …

sections.title: Good manufacturing practices for pharmaceutical products
sections.text: Good manufacturing practices were generally implemented. Necessary human and physical resources with adequate premises, equipment and utilities were provided for the current operational level of FPP activity. Manufacturing processes were generally adequately defined. The manufacturing processes follow procedures as defined and documented in the BMRs and BPRs. The personnel were appropriately qualified and adequate training is conducted.
sections.text_ko: GMP는 대체로 이행되고 있었다. FPP 활동의 현재 운영 수준에 맞게 필요한 인적·물적 자원이 적절한 건물, 설비 및 유틸리티와 함께 제공되고 있었다. 제조 공정은 대체로 적절하게 정의되어 있었다. 제조 공정은 BMR 및 BPR에 정의되고 문서화된 절차를 따르고 있었다. 인원은 적절한 자격을 갖추고 있었고 충분한 교육훈련이 실시되고 있었다.

sections.title: Sanitation and hygiene
sections.text: Premises and equipment in the FPP production area were maintained at a satisfactory level of cleanliness at the time of inspection. Personal hygiene and sanitation appeared satisfactory. Areas were cleaned frequently in accordance with an approved written programme. Personnel at the site were seen to be performing their duties in an organized and diligent manner.
sections.text_ko: FPP 생산 구역의 건물과 설비는 실사 당시 만족스러운 수준의 청결 상태로 유지되고 있었다. 개인위생과 위생관리는 만족스러운 것으로 보였다. 구역은 승인된 서면 프로그램에 따라 빈번히 청소되었다. 현장 인원은 체계적이고 성실하게 업무를 수행하는 것이 관찰되었다.

sections.title: Qualification and validation
sections.text: Validation master plan An approved VMP was available and reviewed. The company qualification and validation policy and programme were defined and documented. Process validation Process validation was performed following approved written procedures. The following PVs were reviewed and discussed. • HA486 Zidovudine Oral Solution, USP 50mg/5mL • HA757 Darunavir/Ritonavir Tablet, Film-coated 400mg/50mg • HA758 Darunavir/Ritonavir Tablet, Film-coated 800mg/100mg The procedure for holding time study was available. The holding time for uncoated and coated tablets were defined upon the study data. …
sections.text_ko: 밸리데이션 마스터 플랜 승인된 VMP가 구비되어 있어 검토하였다. 회사의 적격성평가 및 밸리데이션 정책과 프로그램이 정의되고 문서화되어 있었다. 공정 밸리데이션 공정 밸리데이션은 승인된 서면 절차에 따라 수행되었다. 다음의 PV를 검토하고 논의하였다. • HA486 Zidovudine Oral Solution, USP 50mg/5mL • HA757 Darunavir/Ritonavir Tablet, Film-coated 400mg/50mg • HA758 Darunavir/Ritonavir Tablet, Film-coated 800mg/100mg 보관시간(holding time) 시험 절차가 구비되어 있었다. 코팅 전 정제와 코팅 정제의 보관시간은 시험 데이터를 근거로 정해져 있었다. …

sections.title: Complaints
sections.text: Product quality complaints were handled according to the procedure “Handling of market complaints and Quality defects”. There were three reportable classifications of Quality complaints: Critical, Major and Minor. For WHO products, the information was provided that there were no complaints for the period of October 2020 to April 2026. Additionally, the current list of complaints for 2026 was reviewed and discussed. It was the responsibility of QA to investigate complaints and implement CAPA if necessary. …
sections.text_ko: 제품 품질 불만은 절차 “Handling of market complaints and Quality defects”에 따라 처리되었다. 보고 대상 품질 불만의 분류는 치명적(Critical), 중대(Major), 경미(Minor)의 세 가지였다. WHO 제품에 대해서는 2020년 10월부터 2026년 4월까지의 기간 동안 불만이 없었다는 정보가 제공되었다. 또한 2026년 현재 불만 목록을 검토하고 논의하였다. 불만을 조사하고 필요한 경우 CAPA를 이행하는 것은 QA의 책임이었다. …

sections.title: Product recalls
sections.text: The SOP for “Product recalls” was reviewed. Recall was classified as Class I, Class II or Class III defect, and the action was required to be initiated within specified time. No batches of WHO products have been recalled in the last five years. Recall simulation was required to be performed for all markets every year if no real recall occurs. The mock recall performance was checked and discussed.
sections.text_ko: “Product recalls” SOP를 검토하였다. 회수는 Class I, Class II 또는 Class III 결함으로 분류되었고, 조치는 정해진 기한 내에 개시하도록 요구되었다. 최근 5년간 회수된 WHO 제품 배치는 없었다. 실제 회수가 발생하지 않는 경우 매년 모든 시장에 대해 회수 모의훈련을 수행하도록 요구되었다. 모의 회수 수행 결과를 확인하고 논의하였다.

sections.title: Contract production, analysis and other activities
sections.text: The SMF and company presentation indicated that all products are manufactured exclusively at Unit-III. No products were outsourced for contract manufacturing, including the WHO prequalified FPPs under inspection. The list of contract laboratories, including their addresses and contact information were documented. This list indicated that external laboratories were used where specialized analytical equipment or capabilities are required.
sections.text_ko: SMF와 회사 발표 자료에 따르면 모든 제품은 Unit-III에서만 제조된다. 실사 대상인 WHO 사전적격평가(prequalified) FPP를 포함하여 위탁 제조로 외주된 제품은 없었다. 주소와 연락처를 포함한 위탁 시험기관 목록이 문서화되어 있었다. 이 목록은 특수한 분석 장비나 역량이 필요한 경우 외부 시험기관이 이용되었음을 나타냈다.
sections.title_ko: 위탁 생산, 분석 및 기타 활동

sections.title: Self-inspection, quality audits and suppliers’ audits and approval
sections.text: Self- Inspection A self-inspection plan and SOP was in place. This was spot-checked in management review and not reviewed in detail. Vendor/Supplier qualification and approval The supplier qualification and approval were managed following SOP “Vendor qualification”. An approved vendor list was maintained and covered all starting materials including APIs, Excipients and packing materials. Vendor audit, auditor’s qualification and audit procedure were addressed.
sections.text_ko: 자체점검 자체점검 계획과 SOP가 마련되어 있었다. 이는 경영 검토에서 표본 확인되었으며 상세하게 검토되지는 않았다. 공급업체 적격성평가 및 승인 공급업체 적격성평가 및 승인은 SOP “Vendor qualification”에 따라 관리되었다. API, 부형제 및 포장재를 포함한 모든 출발물질을 포괄하는 승인 공급업체 목록이 유지되었다. 공급업체 감사, 감사자 자격 및 감사 절차가 다루어졌다.
sections.title_ko: 자체점검, 품질 감사 및 공급업체 감사와 승인

sections.title: Personnel
sections.text: An organization chart was available. Key personnel responsibilities were defined in job descriptions. The key personnel in various departments had pharmaceutical qualifications and were well experienced in pharmaceutical manufacturing. In general personnel met during the inspection were aware and followed the GMP principles with appropriate qualifications and experience.
sections.text_ko: 조직도가 구비되어 있었다. 핵심 인원의 책임은 직무기술서에 정의되어 있었다. 각 부서의 핵심 인원은 약학 관련 자격을 갖추고 있었고 의약품 제조 경험이 풍부하였다. 대체로 실사 중 면담한 인원은 GMP 원칙을 인지하고 이를 따르고 있었으며, 적절한 자격과 경험을 갖추고 있었다.

sections.title: Training
sections.text: QA was responsible for training of personnel. Training was required for newly appointed and job specific training and re-training in the event of personnel errors, resulting in a CAPA event. Training programme was not reviewed in detail during the inspection.
sections.text_ko: QA는 인원 교육훈련을 담당하였다. 교육훈련은 신규 채용자, 직무별 교육, 그리고 인원의 오류로 CAPA 사례가 발생한 경우의 재교육에 대해 요구되었다. 교육훈련 프로그램은 실사 중 상세하게 검토되지 않았다.

sections.title: Personal hygiene
sections.text: Personnel hygiene requirements were documented in written procedures. The procedure for entry and exit through change room was reviewed. The requirements for entering the Grade D cleanrooms were clearly documented and included pictorial drawings in the changing rooms. Staff observed in these areas were dressed in the appropriate protective clothing.
sections.text_ko: 개인위생 요건은 서면 절차에 문서화되어 있었다. 갱의실 출입 및 퇴실 절차를 검토하였다. Grade D 청정실 출입 요건은 갱의실의 그림 도해를 포함하여 명확히 문서화되어 있었다. 이 구역에서 관찰된 직원은 적절한 보호복을 착용하고 있었다.

sections.title: Premises
sections.text: The production facility was consisted of three blocks i.e. Block A, Block B and Module IX, Block B. The production blocks were multi-product and non-dedicated to the products manufactured in the block. Central warehouse The warehouse, located about 6 km away from Unit III was used for receipt and storage of excipients, packaging materials and finished goods, including sampling of excipients / packing materials and dispensing of packing materials. QC laboratories The laboratory areas were separate from the production areas. …
sections.text_ko: 생산 시설은 Block A, Block B 및 Module IX, Block B의 세 개 블록으로 구성되어 있었다. 생산동은 다품목용이었으며 해당 블록에서 제조되는 제품 전용이 아니었다. 중앙 창고 Unit III에서 약 6 km 떨어진 곳에 위치한 창고는 부형제, 포장재 및 완제품의 입고와 보관, 그리고 부형제/포장재의 시료채취와 포장재의 칭량 분주에 사용되었다. QC 시험실 시험실 구역은 생산 구역과 분리되어 있었다. …

sections.title: Equipment
sections.text: Equipment installed in the production blocks was multi-purpose and each piece of equipment had a unique identification number. The equipment viewed appeared to be of suitable design and construction for the allocated process in general. Equipment maintenance The equipment viewed during the inspection appeared to have been suitably maintained and in good condition. Equipment status labels were available. The procedure for equipment preventive maintenance was available. Equipment cleaning Equipment cleaning followed approved procedures. …
sections.text_ko: 생산동에 설치된 설비는 다목적이었으며 각 설비에는 고유 식별번호가 있었다. 검토한 설비는 배정된 공정에 대해 대체로 적합한 설계와 구조를 갖춘 것으로 보였다. 설비 유지관리 실사 중 확인한 설비는 적절히 유지관리되어 양호한 상태인 것으로 보였다. 설비 상태 라벨이 구비되어 있었다. 설비 예방 정비 절차가 구비되어 있었다. 설비 세척 설비 세척은 승인된 절차를 따랐다. …

sections.title: Materials Management
sections.text: Incoming materials and finished products were quarantined after receipt until released for use or distribution. The starting material and finished goods were managed by SAP system. Starting material, packaging material and FPPs were stored in different warehouses under the specified conditions. The warehouses onsite and the Central warehouse were visited during the inspection. The raw material warehouse was equipped with sampling booths and dispensing booths under LAF with separate entrances for materials and personal. …
sections.text_ko: 입고된 자재와 완제품은 입고 후 사용 또는 출하가 승인될 때까지 격리되었다. 출발물질과 완제품은 SAP 시스템으로 관리되었다. 출발물질, 포장재 및 FPP는 지정된 조건에서 서로 다른 창고에 보관되었다. 실사 중 현장 창고와 중앙 창고를 방문하였다. 원료 창고에는 LAF 하에 시료채취 부스와 칭량 분주 부스가 갖추어져 있었고, 자재용과 인원용 출입구가 분리되어 있었다. …

sections.title: Documentation
sections.text: Documentation was designed, prepared, reviewed and distributed according to an approved procedure. Computerised systems were used for management of quality system and handling of documents. Approved, signed and dated testing procedures and specifications were available for starting and packaging materials and for finished products. Batch numbering system and BMR management The procedure for product batch numbering and management was reviewed. The procedure included a list which addressed assignment of batch numbers in different scenarios. …
sections.text_ko: 문서는 승인된 절차에 따라 설계, 작성, 검토 및 배포되었다. 품질 시스템 관리와 문서 처리에 전산화 시스템이 사용되었다. 출발물질, 포장재 및 완제품에 대해 승인, 서명 및 일자 기재가 된 시험 절차와 규격이 구비되어 있었다. 배치 번호 부여 체계 및 BMR 관리 제품 배치 번호 부여 및 관리 절차를 검토하였다. 이 절차에는 다양한 상황에서의 배치 번호 부여를 다루는 목록이 포함되어 있었다. …

sections.title: Good practices in production
sections.text: The manufacturing processes were performed and recorded according to instructions in the batch production records. Production of several batches of Dolutegravir (Sodium)/Lamivudine/Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (DLT) Tablet, Film-coated, 50mg/300mg/300mg and oral liquid product were in operation at the time of inspection. Tablets and oral liquids manufacturing steps were briefly inspected. In-process controls were conducted inside of the processing room in the production blocks. Appropriate testing equipment was available. The frequency and limits were defined in the BMRs. …
sections.text_ko: 제조 공정은 배치 생산 기록서의 지시에 따라 수행되고 기록되었다. 실사 당시 Dolutegravir (Sodium)/Lamivudine/Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (DLT) Tablet, Film-coated, 50mg/300mg/300mg 및 경구용 액제 제품의 여러 배치 생산이 진행 중이었다. 정제 및 경구용 액제의 제조 단계를 간략히 점검하였다. 공정 중 관리는 생산동 내 공정실 안에서 수행되었다. 적절한 시험 장비가 구비되어 있었다. 빈도와 한도는 BMR에 정의되어 있었다. …

deterministic_detail.outcome_ko: 점검한 구역, 면담한 인원 및 검토한 문서를 바탕으로, 그리고 실사 보고서(Inspection Report)에 기재된 관찰사항을 포함한 실사 결과를 고려하여, Survey No. 51, Plot 22-110, Industrial Development Area (I.D.A.), Jeedimetla, Hyderabad-500055, Telangana State, India에 소재한 Hetero Laboratories Limited (Unit-III)는 WHO GMP 가이드라인에 대해 허용 가능한 수준의 준수 상태로 운영되고 있는 것으로 판단되었다. 전체 보고서에 기재된 것과 WHOPIR에 반영된 것을 포함하여 실사 중 확인된 모든 부적합 사항은 WHOPIR 공표 이전에 제조업체에 의해 만족스러운 수준으로 시정되었다. 이 WHOPIR는 해당 기간 중 수행되는 모든 실사의 결과가 긍정적인 경우에 한하여 3년간 유효하다.

en.title_issue: WHO inspection of a finished product site
en.summary: WHO published a public inspection report (WHOPIR) for Hetero Labs (Unit III Jeedimetla - FPP) from the 2026-04-27 inspection, noting a documented quality assurance system with procedures covering the main quality elements.
en.implication: A finished pharmaceutical product (FPP) site WHOPIR opening with confirmation of a documented quality system signals that a complete procedural framework is a baseline expectation in WHO inspections. A company sourcing finished products from this site should check the rest of the report as part of contract manufacturer oversight.
key_facts: Subject: Hetero Labs (Unit III Jeedimetla - FPP)
Inspection date: 2026-04-27
Site type: FPP
Quality system: documented QA system with procedures covering main quality elements
checks: Whether the WHOPIR for the contract finished-product site has been obtained and reviewed
Whether quality system procedures cover the main quality elements

cards.summary: WHO는 Hetero Labs (Unit 5 Polepally)에 대한 2026-04-21 실사 공개 보고서(WHOPIR)를 게시했으며, 문서화된 품질보증 시스템과 생산 부서에서 분리된 QA·QC 조직이 확인됐다.
key_facts: 대상: Hetero Labs (Unit 5 Polepally)
품질시스템: 주요 품질 요소를 다루는 절차를 갖춘 문서화된 QA 시스템
조직: Quality Department가 QA와 QC로 나뉘고 생산 부서와 분리
cards.implication: 품질 부서를 QA와 QC로 나누고 생산과 분리한 구조가 WHOPIR에 명시된 것은 조직상 역할 분리가 PQS 평가의 출발점이라는 신호다. 해당 시설 제품을 조달하는 업체라면 보고서의 후속 항목을 공급자 평가에 반영할지 점검해 둘 필요가 있다.
checks: QA·QC 기능 분리와 생산 부서로부터의 독립성
주요 품질 요소별 절차의 문서화 범위

deterministic_detail.outcome: Based on the areas inspected, the people met and the documents reviewed, and considering the findings of the inspection, including the observations listed in the Inspection Report, Hetero La- boratories Limited (Unit-V) located at Survey No. 439, 440, 441 & 458, TSIIC Pharma SEZ, Polepally Village, Jadcherla Mandal, Mahaboobnagar District, Telangana State – 509301 was considered to be operating at an acceptable level of compliance with WHO GMP Guidelines. All the non-compliances observed during the inspection that were listed in the full report as well as those reflected in the WHOPIR, were addressed by the manufacturer, to a satisfactory level, prior to the publication of the WHOPIR. This WHOPIR will remain valid for three years, provided that the outcome of any inspection con- ducted during this period is positive.

sections.title: Pharmaceutical quality system
sections.text: A documented system for quality assurance was established, with procedures covering key quality elements in place. The Quality Department was divided into QA and QC and were separate from the Production Department. Operations were specified in written form and critical GMP require- ments were essentially being met. Annual Product Quality Review The company had a procedure in place for conducting annual product quality reviews. The APQR schedule was prepared at the beginning of each year. The 2025 schedule and 2026 schedule were available. …
sections.text_ko: 품질보증을 위한 문서화된 체계가 수립되어 있었고, 핵심 품질 요소를 다루는 절차가 마련되어 있었다. 품질 부서는 QA와 QC로 나뉘어 있었으며 생산 부서와 분리되어 있었다. 작업은 서면으로 명시되어 있었고 중요한 GMP 요건은 기본적으로 충족되고 있었다. 연간 제품 품질 검토 회사는 연간 제품 품질 검토를 수행하기 위한 절차를 갖추고 있었다. APQR 일정은 매년 초에 작성되었다. 2025년 일정과 2026년 일정이 구비되어 있었다. …

sections.title: Good manufacturing practices for pharmaceutical products
sections.text: Good manufacturing practices were generally implemented. Necessary human and physical resources with adequate premises, equipment and utilities were provided for the current operational level of FPP activity. Manufacturing processes were generally adequately defined. The manufacturing processes follow procedures as defined and documented in the BMRs and BPRs. The personnel were appropriately qualified and adequate training is conducted.
sections.text_ko: GMP는 대체로 이행되고 있었다. FPP 활동의 현재 운영 수준에 맞게 필요한 인적·물적 자원이 적절한 건물, 설비 및 유틸리티와 함께 제공되고 있었다. 제조 공정은 대체로 적절하게 정의되어 있었다. 제조 공정은 BMR 및 BPR에 정의되고 문서화된 절차를 따르고 있었다. 인원은 적절한 자격을 갖추고 있었고 충분한 교육훈련이 실시되고 있었다.

sections.title: Sanitation and hygiene
sections.text: The premises and equipment in the FPP production area were clean and well-maintained at the time of inspection. Personal hygiene and sanitation also appeared satisfactory. Areas were cleaned fre- quently in accordance with an approved written programme. Personnel at the site were seen to be performing their duties in an organised and diligent manner.
sections.text_ko: FPP 생산 구역의 건물과 설비는 실사 당시 청결하고 잘 유지관리되고 있었다. 개인위생과 위생관리도 만족스러운 것으로 보였다. 구역은 승인된 서면 프로그램에 따라 빈번히 청소되었다. 현장 인원은 체계적이고 성실하게 업무를 수행하는 것이 관찰되었다.

sections.title: Qualification and validation
sections.text: Validation master plan An approved VMP was available and reviewed. The company qualification and validation policy and programme were defined and documented. Process validation Process validation was performed following approved written procedures. The process validation of HP029 Sofosbuvir and Velpatasvir Tablets 400 mg/ 100 mg and HA696 Dolutegravir (Sodium)/Lamivudine/Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate Tablet, Film-coated 50mg/300mg/300mg were checked and discussed. Computerised System (CS) validation Additional VMP was generated for the computerised systems. …
sections.text_ko: 밸리데이션 마스터 플랜 승인된 VMP가 구비되어 있어 검토하였다. 회사의 적격성평가 및 밸리데이션 정책과 프로그램이 정의되고 문서화되어 있었다. 공정 밸리데이션 공정 밸리데이션은 승인된 서면 절차에 따라 수행되었다. HP029 Sofosbuvir and Velpatasvir Tablets 400 mg/ 100 mg 및 HA696 Dolutegravir (Sodium)/Lamivudine/Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate Tablet, Film-coated 50mg/300mg/300mg의 공정 밸리데이션을 확인하고 논의하였다. 전산화 시스템(CS) 밸리데이션 전산화 시스템을 위한 추가 VMP가 작성되었다. …

sections.title: Complaints
sections.text: Product quality complaints were handled according to the procedure “Handling of market com- plaints and Quality defects”. There were three reportable classifications of Quality complaints: Crit- ical, Major and Minor. For WHO products a list of complaints was provided. Additionally, the cur- rent list of complaints for the year 2026 was checked and discussed. It was the responsibility of QA to investigate complaints and implement CAPA if necessary. …
sections.text_ko: 제품 품질 불만은 절차 “Handling of market complaints and Quality defects”에 따라 처리되었다. 보고 대상 품질 불만의 분류는 치명적(Critical), 중대(Major), 경미(Minor)의 세 가지였다. WHO 제품에 대해서는 불만 목록이 제공되었다. 또한 2026년 현재 불만 목록을 확인하고 논의하였다. 불만을 조사하고 필요한 경우 CAPA를 이행하는 것은 QA의 책임이었다. …

sections.title: Product recalls
sections.text: The SOP for “Product recalls” was reviewed. Recall was classified as Class I, Class II or Class III defect, and the action is required to be initiated within specified time. No batch of WHO products has been recalled in last three years. Recall simulation was required to be performed for all markets every year if no real recall occurs. A class I mock recall was performed in Feb/2026. It was concluded that the recall procedure was robust and fit to handle the real time recall situation.
sections.text_ko: “Product recalls” SOP를 검토하였다. 회수는 Class I, Class II 또는 Class III 결함으로 분류되었고, 조치는 정해진 기한 내에 개시하도록 요구되었다. 최근 3년간 회수된 WHO 제품 배치는 없었다. 실제 회수가 발생하지 않는 경우 매년 모든 시장에 대해 회수 모의훈련을 수행하도록 요구되었다. 2026년 2월에 Class I 모의 회수가 수행되었다. 회수 절차는 견고하며 실제 회수 상황에 대처하기에 적합하다는 결론이 내려졌다.

sections.title: Contract production, analysis and other activities
sections.text: Hetero Labs has confirmed that all products are manufactured on-site by Unit-V only. No product has been given for contract manufacturing. The list of contract laboratories, including the addresses and contact information was available. The details were not reviewed during this inspection.
sections.text_ko: Hetero Labs는 모든 제품이 Unit-V에서만 현장 제조되며 위탁 제조로 제공된 제품은 없음을 확인하였다. 주소와 연락처를 포함한 위탁 시험기관 목록이 구비되어 있었다. 그 세부 내용은 이번 실사 중 검토되지 않았다.
sections.title_ko: 위탁 생산, 분석 및 기타 활동

sections.title: Self-inspection, quality audits and suppliers’ audits and approval
sections.text: Self- Inspection A self-inspection plan and SOP was in place. This was spot checked in management review and not reviewed in detail. Vendor/Supplier qualification and approval The supplier qualification and approval were managed following SOP “Vendor qualification”. An approved vendor list was maintained and covered all starting materials including APIs, Excipients and packing materials. Vendor audit, auditor’s qualification and audit procedure were addressed. Vendor requalification schedule 2026 was available and monitored.
sections.text_ko: 자체점검 자체점검 계획과 SOP가 마련되어 있었다. 이는 경영 검토에서 표본 확인되었으며 상세하게 검토되지는 않았다. 공급업체 적격성평가 및 승인 공급업체 적격성평가 및 승인은 SOP “Vendor qualification”에 따라 관리되었다. API, 부형제 및 포장재를 포함한 모든 출발물질을 포괄하는 승인 공급업체 목록이 유지되었다. 공급업체 감사, 감사자 자격 및 감사 절차가 다루어졌다. 2026년 공급업체 재적격성평가 일정이 구비되어 있었고 모니터링되고 있었다.
sections.title_ko: 자체점검, 품질 감사 및 공급업체 감사와 승인

sections.title: Personnel
sections.text: An organization chart was available. Key personnel responsibilities were defined in job descrip- tions. The key personnel of the various departments had pharmaceutical qualifications and were well experienced in pharmaceutical manufacturing. In general personnel met during the inspection are aware and follow the GMP principles with appropriate qualifications and experience.
sections.text_ko: 조직도가 구비되어 있었다. 핵심 인원의 책임은 직무기술서에 정의되어 있었다. 각 부서의 핵심 인원은 약학 관련 자격을 갖추고 있었고 의약품 제조 경험이 풍부하였다. 대체로 실사 중 면담한 인원은 GMP 원칙을 인지하고 이를 따르고 있었으며, 적절한 자격과 경험을 갖추고 있었다.

sections.title: Training
sections.text: QA was responsible for training of personnel. Training was required for newly appointed and job specific training and re-training in the event of personnel errors, resulting in a CAPA event. Training programme was not reviewed in detail during this inspection.
sections.text_ko: QA는 인원 교육훈련을 담당하였다. 교육훈련은 신규 채용자, 직무별 교육, 그리고 인원의 오류로 CAPA 사례가 발생한 경우의 재교육에 대해 요구되었다. 교육훈련 프로그램은 이번 실사 중 상세하게 검토되지 않았다.

sections.title: Personal hygiene
sections.text: Personnel hygiene requirements were documented in written procedures. The requirements for en- try Grade D cleanrooms were well documented, including pictorial drawings in change rooms. Staff observed in these areas were dressed in appropriate protective clothing.
sections.text_ko: 개인위생 요건은 서면 절차에 문서화되어 있었다. Grade D 청정실 출입 요건은 갱의실의 그림 도해를 포함하여 잘 문서화되어 있었다. 이 구역에서 관찰된 직원은 적절한 보호복을 착용하고 있었다.

sections.title: Premises
sections.text: Production blocks were multi-product and not dedicated. Manufacturing areas were of a good stand- ard and suitable for the activities conducted therein. Exposed surfaces were smooth, impervious and unbroken to minimize the shedding or accumulation of particles or microorganisms and permitted the repeated application of cleaning. The classified areas were monitored for temperature and relative humidity with BMS system for environmental control. Pressure differentials were monitored manually based on the differential pressure indicators installed. …
sections.text_ko: 생산동은 다품목용이었으며 전용이 아니었다. 제조 구역은 양호한 수준이었고 그곳에서 수행되는 활동에 적합하였다. 노출된 표면은 입자 또는 미생물의 탈락이나 축적을 최소화하도록 매끄럽고 불투과성이며 파손이 없었고 반복적인 세척이 가능하였다. 등급 구역은 환경 관리를 위해 BMS 시스템으로 온도와 상대습도가 모니터링되었다. 차압은 설치된 차압계 표시에 따라 수동으로 모니터링되었다. …

sections.title: Equipment
sections.text: Equipment installed in the production blocks was multi-purpose and each piece of equipment had a unique identification number. The equipment viewed appeared to be of suitable design and con- struction for the allocated process in general. Equipment maintenance The equipment viewed during the inspection appeared to have been suitably maintained and in good condition. Equipment status labels were available. Equipment cleaning In general, the production facilities were well maintained, and equipment was free of dust and resi- dues at the time of inspection.
sections.text_ko: 생산동에 설치된 설비는 다목적이었으며 각 설비에는 고유 식별번호가 있었다. 검토한 설비는 배정된 공정에 대해 대체로 적합한 설계와 구조를 갖춘 것으로 보였다. 설비 유지관리 실사 중 확인한 설비는 적절히 유지관리되어 양호한 상태인 것으로 보였다. 설비 상태 라벨이 구비되어 있었다. 설비 세척 대체로 생산 시설은 잘 유지관리되고 있었으며 실사 당시 설비에는 먼지와 잔류물이 없었다.

sections.title: Materials Management
sections.text: Incoming materials and finished products were quarantined after receipt until released for use or distribution. Status of raw material was indicated, with respect to material under quarantine, ap- proved, and retest etc. The starting material and finished goods were managed by SAP system. Starting material, packaging material and FPPs were stored in different warehouses under the spec- ified conditions. The warehouses in Blocks V and VA were visited during the inspection. The codes and locations for starting material and finished goods were available in the SAP system and spot checked. …
sections.text_ko: 입고된 자재와 완제품은 입고 후 사용 또는 출하가 승인될 때까지 격리되었다. 원료의 상태는 격리, 승인, 재시험 등과 관련하여 표시되어 있었다. 출발물질과 완제품은 SAP 시스템으로 관리되었다. 출발물질, 포장재 및 FPP는 지정된 조건에서 서로 다른 창고에 보관되었다. 실사 중 Block V 및 VA의 창고를 방문하였다. 출발물질과 완제품의 코드 및 위치는 SAP 시스템에 구비되어 있었고 표본 확인되었다. …

sections.title: Documentation
sections.text: Documentation was designed, prepared, reviewed and distributed according to an approved proce- dure. Computerised systems were used for management of quality system and handling of docu- ments. Approved, signed and dated testing procedures and specifications were available for starting and packaging materials and for finished products. Analytical work sheets were generated from the LIMS. Batch numbering system and BMR management The SOP “Allotment of batch numbers” and SOP “Issue and control of BPR through batch record issuance management system application” were reviewed. …
sections.text_ko: 문서는 승인된 절차에 따라 설계, 작성, 검토 및 배포되었다. 품질 시스템 관리와 문서 처리에 전산화 시스템이 사용되었다. 출발물질, 포장재 및 완제품에 대해 승인, 서명 및 일자 기재가 된 시험 절차와 규격이 구비되어 있었다. 시험 분석 워크시트는 LIMS에서 생성되었다. 배치 번호 부여 체계 및 BMR 관리 SOP “Allotment of batch numbers” 및 SOP “Issue and control of BPR through batch record issuance management system application”을 검토하였다. …

sections.title: Good practices in production
sections.text: The manufacturing processes were performed and recorded according to instructions in the batch production records. Production of several tablets was in operation at the time of inspection. Tablet’s manufacturing steps including material dispensing, granulation, compression, coating and primary, secondary packaging areas were inspected. In-process control was conducted inside of processing room in the production blocks. Appropriate testing equipment was available. Recovery and reprocessing were handled following SOP “Procedure for handling if rejects during packing operation”. …
sections.text_ko: 제조 공정은 배치 생산 기록서의 지시에 따라 수행되고 기록되었다. 실사 당시 여러 정제의 생산이 진행 중이었다. 자재 칭량, 과립화, 타정, 코팅, 1차 및 2차 포장 구역을 포함한 정제 제조 단계를 점검하였다. 공정 중 관리는 생산동 내 공정실 안에서 수행되었다. 적절한 시험 장비가 구비되어 있었다. 회수 및 재처리는 SOP “Procedure for handling if rejects during packing operation”에 따라 처리되었다. …

deterministic_detail.outcome_ko: 점검한 구역, 면담한 인원 및 검토한 문서를 바탕으로, 그리고 실사 보고서(Inspection Report)에 기재된 관찰사항을 포함한 실사 결과를 고려하여, Survey No. 439, 440, 441 & 458, TSIIC Pharma SEZ, Polepally Village, Jadcherla Mandal, Mahaboobnagar District, Telangana State – 509301에 소재한 Hetero Laboratories Limited (Unit-V)는 WHO GMP 가이드라인에 대해 허용 가능한 수준의 준수 상태로 운영되고 있는 것으로 판단되었다. 전체 보고서에 기재된 것과 WHOPIR에 반영된 것을 포함하여 실사 중 확인된 모든 부적합 사항은 WHOPIR 공표 이전에 제조업체에 의해 만족스러운 수준으로 시정되었다. 이 WHOPIR는 해당 기간 중 수행되는 모든 실사의 결과가 긍정적인 경우에 한하여 3년간 유효하다.

en.title_issue: Quality system with separate QA and QC
en.summary: WHO published a public inspection report (WHOPIR) for Hetero Labs (Unit 5 Polepally) from the 2026-04-21 inspection, noting a documented QA system and QA/QC units separate from production.
en.implication: The WHOPIR stating that the quality department is split into QA and QC and separated from production signals that organizational role separation is the starting point of PQS assessment. A company procuring from this site should check whether the report's follow-up items feed into supplier evaluation.
key_facts: Subject: Hetero Labs (Unit 5 Polepally)
Inspection date: 2026-04-21
Quality system: documented QA system with procedures covering main quality elements
Organization: Quality Department split into QA and QC, separate from production
checks: Separation of QA and QC functions and independence from production
Documentation coverage of procedures for the main quality elements

deterministic_detail.body: DMRC reference number DMRC - 41252013 Marketing Authorisation Holder Advanz Pharma Limited Medicine Details Mynzepli 40 mg/mL solution for injection in pre-filled syringe PL: 56734/0022 Active Ingredient: aflibercept SNOMED code: 45567511000001107 GTIN: 05021691005605 Affected Lot Batch Numbers Batch No. Expiry Date Pack Size First Distributed 2325742 Jun-2027 1 02/01/2026 2325726 May-2027 1 10/10/2025 Background Advanz Pharma Limited are recalling the specified batches of Mynzepli 40 mg/mL solution for injection in pre-filled syringe as a precautionary measure because a small variation in the size of the finger grip could affect how the medicine is administered and potentially pose a risk to patient safety. The finger grip/flange provides a platform/surface for better grip of the syringe. It allows the user to securely hold the pre-filled syringe while applying pressure to the plunger rod during product administration. Advice for Healthcare Professionals: Stop supplying the above batches immediately. Quarantine all remaining stock and return it to your supplier using your supplier’s approved process. Advanz Pharma have confirmed that other unaffected batches of Mynzepli 40 mg/mL solution for injection in pre-filled syringe are currently available for distribution. Advice for Patients: This is a Pharmacy and Wholesaler level recall, therefore no further action is required by patients. This product is only administered by a qualified healthcare professional experienced in administering intravitreal injections. Patients who experience adverse reactions or have any questions about the medication should seek medical attention. Any suspected adverse reactions should also be reported via the MHRA Yellow Card scheme . Additional information: For all enquiries and information on this product, please email medicalinformation@advanzpharma.com , or telephone +44 (0) 208 588 9131. Recipients of this Medicines Recall should bring it to the attention of relevant contacts by copy of this notice. NHS regional teams are asked to forward this to community pharmacists and dispensing general practitioners for information. Yours faithfully Defective Medicines Report Centre 10 South Colonnade Canary Wharf London E14 4PU Telephone +44 (0)20 3080 6574 DMRC@mhra.gov.uk Download document Class 2 Medicines Recall: Advanz Pharma Limited, Mynzepli 40 mg/mL solution for injection in pre-filled syringe, EL(26)A/44

deterministic_detail.body: DMRC reference number DMRC - 41285957 Marketing Authorisation Holder Accord-UK Ltd Medicine Details Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 10mg Film-Coated Tablets PL: 00142/1154 Active Ingredient: lercanidipine hydrochloride SNOMED code: 16607111000001105 GTIN: 05055565768242 Affected Lot Batch Numbers Batch No. Expiry Date Pack Size First Distributed M2510877 11/2028 28 24/06/2026 Background Accord-UK Ltd is recalling one batch of Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 10mg Tablets due to a packaging mix-up involving the incorrect strength. One complaint has been received to date, in which a sealed carton of Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 10mg Tablets 28 (Batch No. M2510877) was found to contain one blister strip of the correct tablets, and one blister strip of Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 20mg Tablets (Batch No. M2510831). This recall is being conducted at the pharmacy and wholesaler level as Accord-UK Limited has shown that the likelihood of the mix up, and the subsequent risk to patients, is low. If a patient prescribed lercanidipine 10 mg were to inadvertently receive 20 mg daily for approximately two weeks, the anticipated risk would be an exaggerated pharmacological effect; particularly reduction in blood pressure with associated symptoms such as dizziness, headache, flushing, palpitations or symptomatic hypotension. However, 20 mg remains within the authorised therapeutic dose range for routine use of this product. The tablets have distinct colours and the occurrence of the defect is currently anticipated to be very low. Advice for Healthcare Professionals: Stop supplying the above batch immediately. Quarantine all remaining stock and return it to your supplier using your supplier’s approved process. This recall is at the pharmacy and wholesaler level and not directed to patient level as 20 mg remains within the authorised therapeutic dose range for routine use of this product. The tablets have distinct colours and the occurrence of the defect is currently anticipated to be very low. However, should a patient present a pack with the incorrect medicine, pharmacy teams should exercise their professional judgement to supply the correct medication. Advice for Patients: Accord has received a single report of a carton of Accord-UK Ltd Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 10 mg Tablets containing a blister strip of Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 20 mg Tablets and are being recalled as a precautionary measure. 20 mg remains within the authorised therapeutic dose range for routine use of this product. The tablets have distinct colours and the occurrence of the defect is currently anticipated to be very low. If you were prescribed Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 10 mg Tablets, and received an Accord pack with batch number M2510877, please carefully check the blister strips inside (the batch number and expiry date information can be found on outer carton, see the images in Annex 1). If the carton contains blister strips that are labelled as Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 10 mg Tablets, you do not need to take further action and may continue to take the tablets. If the carton contains a blister strip that is labelled as Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 20 mg Tablets, do not take the medicine, contact your pharmacy. If you believe you have taken the Lercanidipine 20 mg Tablets and are currently experiencing any side effects such as dizziness, headache, flushing or palpitations then please seek immediate medical advice. Please take the leaflet that came with your medicine and any remaining tablets with you to your pharmacy or GP practice. If you are unsure or have any questions, please seek advice from your pharmacy or other healthcare professionals involved in your treatment. Patients who experience adverse reactions or have any questions about the medication should seek medical attention. Any suspected adverse reactions should also be reported via the MHRA Yellow Card scheme. Additional information: For all medical information enquiries and information on this product, please email Accord-UK Medical Information Department medinfo@accord-healthcare.com , or telephone 01271 385257. For stock control enquiries please email Accord-UK Customer Services Team customerservices@accord-healthcare.com , or telephone 0800 373573. Recipients of this Medicines Recall should bring it to the attention of relevant contacts by copy of this notice. NHS regional teams are asked to forward this to community pharmacists and dispensing general practitioners for information. Yours faithfully Defective Medicines Report Centre 10 South Colonnade Canary Wharf London E14 4PU Telephone +44 (0)20 3080 6574 DMRC@mhra.gov.uk Download document Class 2 Medicines Recall: Accord-UK Ltd, Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 10mg Film-Coated Tablets, EL(26)A/45 Annex 1 Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 10mg Tablets – Carton Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 10mg Tablets – showing Batch details Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 10mg Tablets – Correct blister of 14 tablets BN M2510877 Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 20mg Tablets – Incorrect blister of 14 tablets BN M2510831 Differences in appearance between Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 10mg Tablets and Lercanidipine Hydrochloride 20mg Tablets.

deterministic_detail.body: DMRC reference number DMRC - 41238898 Marketing Authorisation Holder Xeal Pharma Medicine Details Clopidogrel Oral Solution, Clopidogrel Oral Suspension Unlicensed medicine (MS 46688) Active Ingredient: clopidogrel hydrogen sulfate SNOMED code: N/A GTIN: N/A Affected Lot Batch Numbers For a list of defected batches, see Annex 1 Background Xeal Pharma have informed MHRA that all strengths of their Clopidogrel Oral Suspension and Clopidogrel Oral Solution products contain less than the labelled amount of clopidogrel. Due to a formulation error, the impacted batches contain 76% of the required amount of clopidogrel. All batches produced prior to this notification are affected. Please note this is a Class 2 Patient, Pharmacy and Wholesaler level recall. Advice for Healthcare Professionals: Stop supplying the above batches immediately. Quarantine all remaining stock and return it to your supplier using your supplier’s approved process. Based on the risk assessment by Xeal Pharma, patient harm is not anticipated in patients receiving the affected product for long-term preventative treatment. However, patients would not receive the full, prescribed dose. Pharmacists should identify and immediately contact all patients who have been dispensed these batches and ask them to confirm if they have remaining stock within their possession. If batch traceability information is not available, all patients dispensed this product from 20 July 2026 should be contacted. Patients should be informed that the product contained a lower dose than prescribed and patients and carers should be reminded that suddenly stopping this medicine may cause serious thrombotic events. If the pharmacist identifies any patients with an impacted product, they should contact the patient’s GP or prescriber and discuss ongoing treatment for the patient. As patients may require monitoring, other clinicians and healthcare professionals may need to be involved. Prescribers, clinicians, and other healthcare professionals involved in the prescribing/monitoring of patients who are using Clopidogrel Oral Solution or Suspension should contact their patients and/or carers directly to ensure that their treatment is reviewed. Healthcare professionals should be aware that there are no licensed clopidogrel oral suspension/solutions available. Patients with impacted batches may require a dose correction, alternative licensed formulations or a different treatment option. Xeal Pharma have confirmed that all future stock will be manufactured with the correct strength and calculations applied. Advice for Patients: Never stop taking medicines such as clopidogrel without medical advice. Suddenly stopping clopidogrel may cause serious thrombotic events. Your GP, specialist, pharmacist, or other healthcare professional will contact you to, where required, make sure you get a new prescription for an alternative product. Once you have a replacement, you should return the impacted product to your pharmacy as part of the recall. You can contact your healthcare professional directly if you are worried, but you should keep taking your medicine as advised until you get an alternative. No reports of patient harm have been received regarding this issue and the recall is being undertaken out of an abundance of caution. Patients who experience adverse reactions or have any questions about the medication should seek medical attention. Any suspected adverse reactions should also be reported via the MHRA Yellow Card scheme . Additional information: For all enquiries and information on this product, please email contact@xealpharma.co.uk , or telephone 0121 3090067. Recipients of this Medicines Recall should bring it to the attention of relevant contacts by copy of this notice. NHS regional teams are asked to forward this to community pharmacists and dispensing general practitioners for information. Yours faithfully Defective Medicines Report Centre 10 South Colonnade Canary Wharf London E14 4PU Telephone +44 (0)20 3080 6574 DMRC@mhra.gov.uk Download document Class 2 Medicines Recall: Xeal Pharma, Clopidogrel Oral Liquids (all strengths), EL(26)A/43

en.title_issue: Impurities/degradation specification failure
en.summary: Zydus Pharmaceuticals (USA) Inc is recalling Hydrocortisone Sodium Succinate for Injection, USP 100 mg/vial as Class II for failed impurities/degradation specifications.
en.implication: An injectable recalled for impurity and degradation specification failure shows that degradant growth during distribution can surface as a market quality issue. Degradant growth can generally relate to storage conditions or formulation stability, so check degradant trends in the stability data.
key_facts: Company: Zydus Pharmaceuticals (USA) Inc
Product: Hydrocortisone Sodium Succinate for Injection, USP 100 mg/vial
Reason: Failed Impurities/Degradation Specifications
Class: Class II
checks: Degradant growth trend in stability testing and margin to specification
History of deviations from distribution and storage conditions

en.title_issue: Combined recall for lack of sterility assurance
en.summary: Houston Rx LLC is recalling two injectable vial products as Class II for the same reason, lack of assurance of sterility.
en.implication: Several injectable products being recalled together for the same reason, lack of sterility assurance, suggests the facility's aseptic process system itself may have been judged the problem rather than individual product defects. Such a lack can generally relate to aseptic process validation or environmental control, so check the assurance basis for the common process.
key_facts: Company: Houston Rx LLC
Reason: Lack of assurance of sterility
Class: Class II
Merged: combined recall of 2 products for the same reason
checks: Status of process simulation (media fill) for the aseptic compounding process
Common risk assessment across injectable products made in the same facility

en.title_issue: Foreign tablets in packaged units recall
en.summary: American Health Packaging is recalling Metoclopramide Tablets, USP, 5 mg, 100 Tablets (10 x 10) as Class II because other tablets or capsules were mixed in.
en.implication: Foreign tablets or capsules were found in a unit dose packaged product, signaling that distributors and repackagers are also subject to mix-up risk control. Mix-ups in unit packaging can generally relate to item verification at the packaging input stage, so check controls at that step.
key_facts: Company: American Health Packaging
Product: Metoclopramide Tablets, USP, 5 mg, 100 Tablets (10 x 10)
Reason: Presence of Foreign Tablets/Capsules
Class: Class II
checks: Product and lot reconciliation before unit dose packaging input
Foreign tablet inspection on the unit dose packaging line

en.title_issue: Recall for possible foreign particles
en.summary: Health Canada announced a Type II recall under Contamination for the affected lot of PMS-FAMPRIDINE 10 mg Tablet from PHARMASCIENCE INC., which may contain foreign particles.
en.implication: A tablet product recalled for possible foreign particles shows that foreign matter control in solid dose processes is tied directly to recall risk. Foreign particles can generally relate to equipment wear or the raw material, so check the in-process foreign matter detection system.
key_facts: Product: PMS-FAMPRIDINE 10 mg Tablet
Reason: Contamination (possible foreign particles)
Class: Type II
Issue date: 2026-09-28
